## Type of Change

- [ ] 🎨 New design template (`templates/<slug>/`)

## Quality Assurance Checklist

- [ ] All tests pass cleanly (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript typecheck passes (`pnpm typecheck`)
- [ ] Full release verification succeeds (`pnpm verify`)
- [ ] Zero secrets or private paths leaked (`pnpm audit:secrets`)
- [ ] New template includes `template.html`, `manifest.json`, `preview.png`, and `sample.deck.md` (if applicable)
- [ ] Dual dark/light theme switching verified (if applicable)
